units.source_text: 结巴，不消说在我和外界之间设置了一道屏障。

en.t: My stutter, needless to say, had set up a barrier between me and the outside world.

units.source_text: 我很难发好第一个字音，

en.t: It was very hard for me to pronounce the first sound properly,

units.source_text: 这第一个字音仿佛是打开我的内心世界和外界之间的门扉的钥匙，

en.t: as though that first sound were the key that opened the door between my inner world and the outside world,

units.source_text: 然而这把钥匙却从不曾顺利地将门扉打开过。

en.t: yet this key had never once opened the door smoothly.

units.source_text: 一般人通过自由操纵语言，可以敞开内心世界与外界之间的门扉，使它通风良好，

en.t: Ordinary people, by freely handling language, can throw open the door between their inner world and the outside world and let the air pass through it,
but no matter what I did, I could not manage it.

units.source_text: 我这把钥匙完全生锈了。
